\tau_{xz}&=-\mu\left(\frac{\partial v_x}{\partial z}+\frac{\partial v_z}{\partial x}\right)

\]

\[

\tau_{yy}&=-2\mu\frac{\partial v_y}{\partial y}+\frac{2}{3}\mu(\nabla\cdot\vec v)\\[6pt]
\tau_{yz}&=-\mu\left(\frac{\partial v_y}{\partial z}+\frac{\partial v_z}{\partial y}\right)
\end{aligned}
\]

\[
\begin{aligned}
\tau_{zx}&=-\mu\left(\frac{\partial v_z}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial v_x}{\partial z}\right)\\[6pt]
\tau_{zy}&=-\mu\left(\frac{\partial v_z}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial v_y}{\partial z}\right)\\[6pt]
\tau_{zz}&=-2\mu\frac{\partial v_z}{\partial z}+\frac{2}{3}\mu(\nabla\cdot\vec v)
\end{aligned}
\]
